name: KaRu
source:
KaRu is a short, horror experience where you play as a Parasite. He wakes up next to a young boy he never met in a place they shouldn't be. Now they have to trust each other and find a way out. The game is about an hour long, and it has four endings! This is meant as an introduction to many more insights to come, taking place within the same universe, so, please do enjoy this little world!
A.M.

Karu is a point & click, multiple-choice/ending, visual novel game.
Navigate around the areas with your cursor and pick the correct choices to reach a better outcome for the protagonist.
Find items that will help paint a clearer picture of where you are, and what happened to those who came before you.
Avoid unnecessary conflict with the characters.

M.A.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1834000/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《KaRu》是一段短篇恐怖体验，你将扮演一个寄生体。他醒来时，身边是一名素未谋面的小男孩，而他们所在的地方，本不该有他们的身影。如今，两人必须彼此信任，共同寻找出路。游戏时长约一小时，共有四种结局！这只是开端，未来还会有更多同一世界观中的故事，揭示更深的秘密。所以，请好好享受这个小小的世界吧！
A.M.

《KaRu》是一款点击操作、拥有多项选择与多种结局的视觉小说。
使用光标在各个区域中探索，作出正确的选择，为主角争取更好的结果。
寻找物品，逐步弄清自己身在何处，以及那些先你而来的人遭遇了什么。
避免与角色发生不必要的冲突。

M.A.

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1834000/]Steam[/url]]
